text:
devrel-liz: Quick heads-up — we just published the Maintainer Sherpa Kit v0.1.0 :tada: 
devrel-liz: TL;DR: interactive onboarding + sandbox repo, checklist for first PR, and a tiny e2e tutorial to reduce ramp from days -> hours. Repo + release: https://github.com/redwood/maintainer-sherpa/releases/tag/v0.1.0
devrel-liz: Office hours tomorrow 10:00am PT in #devrel-qa if folks want a walk-through or to help onboard new maintainers :coffee:
ci-bot: CI: Published release artifacts and tag `v0.1.0` for redwood/maintainer-sherpa — all checks passed ✅
samir: love this — can we add a short security checklist (SRI + token scanning) to the onboarding checklist? want to share with infra team before external volunteers onboard
maia: added a small template for security checks under docs/security-checklist.md — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/maintainer-sherpa/pull/14
michaela: tiny nit: step 3 in CONTRIBUTING.md says "run yarn test:ci" but the repo uses `pnpm` — i'll open a quick fix
olivia: this is great — i'll post a short blurb to the community newsletter and flag maintainers slack channel :megaphone:
devrel-liz: @samir thanks — we'll fold your items into the checklist before the next batch of volunteers. For anyone curious, quick start snippet:
```
# initialize local sandbox
redwoodctl clone redwood/maintainer-sherpa --sandbox
cd maintainer-sherpa
pnpm install
pnpm run dev
```
devrel-liz: If you want to test onboarding flows, use `test-account-01` in the sandbox (no real secrets). Ping me in-thread or at @devrel-liz for access to the mentor queue. :handshake:
maia: will join office hours and bring a quick demo of the new checklist UI
michaela: PR for the CONTRIBUTING.md fix is up: https://github.com/redwood/maintainer-sherpa/pull/15 — will merge after CI
devrel-liz: Thanks everyone! Huge props to the contributors and early reviewers. We'll track feedback in the repo issues labeled `onboarding-feedback` and iterate fast. :rocket:
